text: A three-hop cycle returned $47.13 of an original $72.32 (34.8% attrition) to accounts linked to broker Eric Maynard and Johnson Medical Centre over 49 days, passing one unowned shell account. It is the shorter sibling of the four-hop loop flagged on the same pair, sharing conduits with it. Small value keeps this alert low-severity, but two distinct closed loops over the same accounts is a structural pattern, not an accident of fees. The honest alternative - coincidental netting of unrelated small payments - becomes less plausible with each additional loop found. Next step: treat this and the companion cycle as one investigation and map every counterparty of the shared shell account.
